title: Tuition Credits When a Pre-K Child Becomes State-Eligible
content:
## Rule in force

For a Pre-K tuition account of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, the move to state-eligible Pre-K takes effect on the first day of the billing month after the basis is on file. A tuition charge already posted for that month or a later one is credited in full with the credit reason "eligibility established", and months before the basis month remain owed. The basis month itself, the enrollment's most recent billing month when the basis comes on file, is credited under the basis-month schedule with the credit reason "eligibility established".

Each credit offsets one named tuition charge and lowers the amount the household owes on the enrollment by the credit; the family sees it next to that month's tuition charge on the statement.

## Posting an eligibility credit: `credit_prek_eligibility_month_43743e06`

**Capability.** The tool books one credit entry, dated today, marked as an eligibility-established credit, that offsets one named tuition charge on the child's Pre-K enrollment.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the support agent unlocks `credit_prek_eligibility_month_43743e06` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `enrollment_ledger_id` | the identifier of the tuition charge entry being offset, as returned by the tuition ledger lookup for the enrollment | text id |
| `amount` | the credit to book | US dollars, a positive number with 2 decimal places; the tool rounds half up to the cent before booking |

**Return.** On success, a one-line receipt beginning "Eligibility credit posted:" gives the new credit entry reference, the tuition charge reference it offsets, the enrollment reference, the amount booked (USD, two decimals) and the posting date (YYYY-MM-DD). A receipt beginning "Error:" means nothing was booked: the charge reference was not found, or the amount was not a positive USD amount.

## Which months are credited (hypothetical case)

The basis comes on file in a hypothetical November, while November is the most recent billing month. The move takes effect on 1 December. A December charge already posted is credited in full; the November charge is the basis month and is credited under the basis-month schedule; September and October remain owed.
